chunks: Ahmad ibn Ziyad narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated to us. He said: Ja'far ibn Salama al-Ahwazi narrated to us from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi. He said: Uthman ibn Abi Shayba and Mahraz ibn Hisham narrated to us. They said: Mutalib ibn Ziyad narrated to us from Layth ibn Abi Sulaym. He said:

The Prophet (may Allah bless him and his family) was approached by Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn (peace be upon them), and each of them was saying: 'I am the most beloved to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family).' So he (s) took Fatima to his stomach, Ali to his back, al-Hasan to his right, and al-Husayn to his left. Then he (s) said: You are from me, and I am from you.

key_terms.أنتم مني وأنا منكم: 'You are from me and I am from you' -- a declaration of the inseparable bond between the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.بطنه: His stomach/chest -- the front of the body, signifying the closest embrace
key_terms.ظهره: His back -- indicating Ali was embraced from behind

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Muhammad say when Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn each claimed to be most beloved to him?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (s) demonstrated his love for his family (Ahl al-Bayt) when Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn (as) each came claiming to be the most beloved to him. In a tender physical gesture, he embraced them all simultaneously -- placing Fatima to his chest, Ali to his back, al-Hasan to his right, and al-Husayn to his left -- and declared: 'You are from me, and I am from you.' This demonstrates the inseparable bond between the Prophet and his family and their equal standing in his love.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Ziyad narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim narrated to us. He said: Ja`far b. Salama al-Ahwazi narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim b. Muhammad al-Thaqafi narrated to us. He said: `Uthman b. Abi Shayba narrated to us with Mahraz b. Hisham. They said: Mutalib b. Ziyad narrated to us from Layth b. Abi Sulaym. He said:

The Prophet (s) met `Ali, Fatima, al-Hasan, and al-Husayn (as), and all of them were saying, “I am the most beloved to the Messenger of Allah (s).” So, he (s) took Fatima to his stomach, `Ali to his back, al-Hasan to his right, and al-Husayn to his left. Then, he (s) said: You are from me, and I am from you.
